decisions.reason: SOL’s 'They ranged from' fixes BASE’s clunky 'Among them were everything,' but dropping 'even' loses 조차.
decisions.replacement: Jin Mukyung had learned countless martial arts over the years. They ranged from Peak-level arts that had once defined an era to Third Rate martial arts easily found even at a street stall in some backwater village.

decisions.reason: 지금 이 순간 is immediate 'this very moment'; SOL’s 'that moment' strips the now.
'I’ve ever learned' is the natural English for 지금까지 익힌; BASE’s 'until now' is calqued.
일도양단 is the force of a single slash cleaving in two; SOL drops the single slash and inflates 'something' to 'anything'.
'A move' avoids echoing 'the first move' while still identifying the well-known form.
Tighter 'capable of more than' and 'looked as though' without changing the Mount Tai image.
'Split second' is the idiomatic English for 찰나에 불과한 시간; 'briefest instant' is translationese.
Pronoun is fine after Mukyung is named, but SOL’s 'was enough to' pads the shiver; keep BASE’s direct verb.
decisions.replacement: The saber qi grazed his clothes by a hair before striking the ground. The sight of the earth splitting wide open without a single boom or tremor sent a shiver through him.

decisions.reason: SOL drops the contrastive 그러나; Pung Yang’s dissatisfaction is set against the dodge.
'So much as a scratch' is the English idiom for 작은 상처 하나 입히지 못했다.
받아치는 is receiving/parrying the blow; 'counter' implies a return attack the next line does not support.
'Seasoned' weakens 완숙한, and 'after blocking' drops 그 대가로 (the price of blocking).
BASE’s 'This much should be dodged' is calqued; SOL renders the 해야지 claim as natural speech.
BASE’s English can be read as 'you could block it'; SOL preserves the sneer that he dodged because he couldn’t.
'Must have been truly desperate' matches 오죽 다급했을까 better than hypothetical 'would have been desperate enough.'
'The face that… cracked' is body-part translationese; SOL makes Mukyung the subject of 피식 웃었다.
대수일까 is a rhetorical question; SOL keeps that shape instead of flattening it to a statement.
Standalone setup is better merged into the quoted 되물었다 beat in H019.
Combines 의중을 알 수 없는 실없는 농담 and 자신도 모르게 되물었다 with the quoted question without losing either.
SOL’s 'began to wonder' genericizes 가벼운 의문; BASE keeps the faint puzzlement.
돌아선 is turning around; 'spun' overstates the physical action.
느리게 흐르는 시간 속에서 is already-slow time, not time slowing 'to a crawl.'
'I was in perfect condition' naturalizes 몸 상태는 완벽했다, and 'small fry' is closer to 조무래기 than 'minions.'
'Stick a spear through it' matches 쑤셔 달라고 and Taekyung’s voice better than generic 'stabbed.'
'Walk away unscathed' is the natural payoff of 맞고 멀쩡한 놈을 못 봤으니까.
The Korean is a fragmentary noun phrase; SOL’s full sentence flattens that beat.
Comma-only change; the two versions are indistinguishable.
멍하니 is blank/dumbfounded, not frozen, and SOL splits away 나를 본 풍양이.
Plural 'regrets' is the idiomatic English for 후회해도 늦었다.
SOL drops 솟구친 (shot up) and replaces specific 허리를 숙여서 with generic 'ducked.'
SOL adds an unstated throat and weakens 기 무섭게; BASE’s 'leaped' is weaker than 몸을 날리다.
decisions.replacement: I swallowed the curse trying to burst out and flung myself away. No sooner had I done so than savage saber strikes shredded the place where I had been standing.

decisions.reason: 'The sight of' matches 광경에; BASE’s 'Seeing' is a looser opener.
Tighter inner-voice English for 까딱했다가는 without changing the death threat.
SOL’s 'might not' weakens 모자랄; BASE’s 'an A-rank magic armor' is ungrammatical and underplays 따로 없다.
decisions.replacement: Even A-rank magic armor wouldn’t have been enough here, yet I was fighting in nothing but a scrap of cloth. This was the very definition of walking on thin ice.

decisions.reason: 무엇보다 is 'more than anything'; 'More importantly' is a different discourse marker.
'Right now' restores 지금의 그는; 'inexhaustible spring' keeps 마르지 않는 샘.
SOL’s 'run like rats' drops 도망치는 (fleeing).
SOL drops 그 순간이었다; BASE keeps the hinge before Mukyung’s line.
Cleaner spoken English for 별로 듣기 좋은 말은 아닌데 without adding content.
SOL’s 'swung his sword' loses 검을 흩뿌렸다; BASE’s 'long' misses 쭉 (straight).
decisions.replacement: Jin Mukyung appeared out of nowhere and scattered a flurry of sword strikes. A streak of blue light shot straight toward Pung Yang’s neck.

decisions.reason: SOL’s 'casually' weakens 여유로운; BASE’s 'rubbed the neck struck' is awkward.
decisions.replacement: But even Jin Mukyung’s Sword Energy, which seemed capable of cutting through anything, couldn’t pierce the Body-Protecting Qi. Pung Yang leisurely rubbed the spot on his neck where the Sword Energy had struck.

decisions.reason: Dropping 'It’s' matches the clipped 뻐근하군 better.
강대한 기세 is singular; SOL’s 'their auras' invents a dual source.
끼어들다 is cutting in/interfering, not merely joining.
SOL drops 마침내, the delayed climax of the charge.
'Nearby' is not in the Korean; 두 다리를 딛고 서 있던 is people planted on both feet.
'Watching for' turns 결과를 지켜보았다 into waiting; BASE keeps observing the result.
Korean is a nominal tableau; SOL’s full sentences flatten that still-image cut.
놈 in Taekyung’s narration is 'the bastard,' not a neutral 'man.'
당당히 is proudly/with dignity; 'stood tall' and 'outcome' loosen 당당히 and 승패.
보진 못했 is inability to see it all, and 틀림없다 is 'no doubt,' not a softer 'must have.'
아마 결정타였을 것이다 is probability; BASE’s 'must have' overstates it.
입가 is the corner of the mouth; SOL generalizes to 'his mouth.'
묵묵부답에 marks cause; SOL’s split weakens the tongue-click as a reaction to the silence.
해야겠군 is compelled 'I’ll have to,' not a milder 'should.'
Standalone 'I was genuinely curious' is better folded into the asking sentence.
'Genuinely curious, I asked' keeps 궁금해져서 물었다 without an extra paragraph.
SOL drops 큰 도움 and turns 보완 (supplement) into 'compensate for.'
'Slipped out' softens 튀어나왔다; BASE’s 'came out on their own' keeps the burst.
'Wore the same expression' is tighter English for 같은 표정 than 'look on their face.'
SOL drops 명확히 from 승패가 명확히 갈린.
Spoken dismissal of 심산유곡에서 수련 reads more naturally without changing the threat.
SOL drops the 북망산 callback and changes 꼭 내가 아니더라도 (if it isn’t me) into inability.
슬금슬금 is creeping/sidling, not merely approaching slowly.
편히 죽긴 글렀군 is dying comfortably/peacefully, not a generic 'easy death.'
SOL genericizes 업보 (karma) and weakens 창을 까딱거렸다 from a flick to a gesture.
Clipped 'Still going to…' fits Taekyung’s challenge better than the extra 'Are you.'
입을 열었다 here means he spoke; 'opening his mouth' is a body-part calque.
'Laboring under a serious misconception' is the idiomatic English for 큰 착각을 하고 있는.
웃음기 is a tinge of a laugh in the voice; 'laughter' is broader.
'Well? What do you think?' is the natural spoken prompt for 자, 내 말에 대해 어떻게 생각하나.
Dummy 'realize it' is better moved onto the why-clauses in the next sentence.
'Only then did I realize why' attaches 그제야 깨달았다 to the two why-beats without a dummy object.
SOL’s 'How long' turns 언제부터 into duration; BASE’s 'body had already lost consciousness' is awkward English.
decisions.replacement: Pung Yang’s hand touched Jin Mukyung’s chest. At what point had it happened? His unconscious body crumpled limply.

decisions.reason: 'Embedded in a neat row across his upper body' is the cleaner English for 나란히 꽂혀.
Makes Pung Yang the subject instead of leaving 'red eyes' as a floating body-part actor.
마무리를 지어 볼까 is wrapping things up; 'finish this' narrows it.
십여 is already 'more than ten' for the later deaths; 'dozen or so' splits the same count.
어김없이 is without fail; 'one after another' adds a sequence the Korean doesn’t state.
Splits the endurance/power/prey information into cleaner English without dropping 개개인의 무력.
Splits 아니지, 그게 아니야 into two beats, matching the doubled refusal.
'If you were the Heaven Shaking Sword, perhaps' tracks 진천검이라면 모를까 more closely than 'I could see it if.'
'Fell silent' naturalizes 입을 다물었다, and 'block his path' matches 막아선.
'As though it were' is stiffer than Taekyung’s 'like it was' for 타들어 가는 것 같다.
절망적이었던 상대 is despair-inducing; 'most hopeless' can sound as if the elder himself was pitiful.
아무도 없다 is existential 'there was no one,' not 'I had no one.'
SOL drops glossary 고수/master from 그 이상의 고수.
SOL’s 'first true crisis' moves 처음으로 onto the crisis; the Korean applies it to losing a subordinate.
욕만 튀어나온다 is curses coming out, not merely wanting to curse.
찌그러져 있어라 is stay crumpled/quiet in place; SOL adds an unstated 'crawl off somewhere.'
SOL’s 'had that pill' drops 잠력단을 믿고 (trusting/relying on it).
'A fact I’d forgotten' matches 잊고 있던 사실 more naturally than 'a forgotten fact.'
'Jopil’s possessions' is tighter English for 갖고 있던 물건 중에.
The rendered name already carries the meaning; the etymology footnote is unnecessary on the thought.
Cleaner 'with the fire qi it contained,' and the jiazi note renumbers after dropping the name footnote.
입을 열었다 here is starting to speak; 'opened my mouth' is a calque before 'Hey.'
'Walked past me' is the natural English for 지나쳐 간.
'Each word' and 'every word' are indistinguishable for 또박또박.
The name is already transparent in English; the literal-breakdown footnote is not needed.
Jiazi note stays and becomes [^4] once the unused name footnote is removed.
